name: Short Desk Break
description: A quick mix of small moves for a break from your screen.

steps.title: Look far away
steps.text: Rest your eyes on something far away, like a window or a tree, for a few slow breaths.

steps.title: Roll your shoulders
steps.text: Roll your shoulders back a few times, slowly.

steps.title: Reach up
steps.text: Raise both arms overhead and stretch tall, then lower them.

steps.title: Shake out your hands
steps.text: Give your hands and wrists a loose little shake.

steps.title: Take a sip of water
steps.text: Have a drink if you like, and breathe out slowly. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
